title: Tourist police - settle this fine, card only
scenario: Someone in uniform stops you on the street, claims you've broken a minor local rule, and says the fine must be paid immediately by card on a handheld device, or your passport will be held.

answers.A: Pay by card immediately to avoid losing your passport.
answers.B: Ask to see identification and a written citation, and offer to settle it at a police station instead.
answers.C: Hand over your passport and card together to resolve it faster.

explanation: Genuine on-the-spot fines are rare and are documented with a written citation; a demand for immediate card payment with a passport threat is a well-known tourist shakedown.
proTip: A real fine survives being paid at a station, with a receipt - a fake one doesn't.
